commands: (command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 && dnf -y install httpd php php-cli php-common php-mysqlnd php-gd php-xml php-mbstring php-intl php-json php-zip php-opcache) || yum install -y httpd php php-cli php-common php-mysqlnd php-gd php-xml php-mbstring php-intl php-json php-zip php-opcache

cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/moodle.conf <<'EOFV'
<VirtualHost *:80>
  DocumentRoot /app/moodle
  DirectoryIndex index.php index.html
  <Directory /app/moodle>
    AllowOverride All
    Require all granted
  </Directory>
  ErrorLog /var/log/httpd/moodle_error.log
  CustomLog /var/log/httpd/moodle_access.log combined
</VirtualHost>
EOFV

if command -v getenforce >/dev/null 2>&1; then SE=$(getenforce); if [ "$SE" = "Enforcing" ] || [ "$SE" = "Permissive" ]; then chcon -R -t httpd_sys_content_t /app/moodle || true; chcon -R -t httpd_sys_rw_content_t /data/moodledata || true; fi; fi
